# An exception that became the procedure

The printer fallback works so well that handwritten tickets are now normal on busy days. The official instructions still describe them as emergency-only. A documented exception can become a better routine, but then its limits need review. [[Maintenance]] should not make people pretend that the work still follows the original plan.
